title: Stroke
description: One ink stroke. `crates/protocol::Stroke` is the source of truth; this schema is asserted against every stroke-bearing fixture by `crates/protocol/tests/schemas.rs`.

id.description: Client-assigned immutable identity. Tombstones target this id.

style.description: Immutable style snapshot captured at stylus-down (`crates/protocol::StrokeStyle`).

tool_kind.description: Rendering model discriminator. Only `solid_round` exists today.

style_version.description: 2 = pressure-modulated nib; points MAY carry pressure. The only accepted version. 1 meant a constant-width nib on which pressure was forbidden; it was retired in iteration 48 and is permanently invalid, never reused.

color.description: Opaque sRGB hex, uppercase, e.g. #006400 (crates/protocol rejects lowercase).

width.description: Nib diameter in world logical px (the full-pressure diameter); 1.0..32.0 in 0.5 steps.
